summary: LUNAR HAVEN is an interactive 3D browser-based survival game designed for ages 7–12. Players manage a Lunar South Pole outpost alongside AI guide NOVI-9 and 5 crew officers, balancing Power, Oxygen, Food, and Radiation Shielding against real-time space weather events powered by NASA's DONKI database. Through 3 mission modes, 9 lunar districts, and an interactive Science Journal, the game bridges play and real NASA science to teach young learners how space exploration works.
details:
LUNAR HAVEN addresses the "Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer" challenge by bridging interactive 3D gameplay with real NASA space science for students aged 7–12.

How It Works:

- 5-Day Survival Mission: Players command a lunar civilization across 9 districts and 5 spacecraft, making critical resource trade-offs between Power, Oxygen (Life Support), Food, and Radiation Shielding.

- Real NASA Space Weather: Integrated with NASA's DONKI (Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information), the game simulates real solar flares and radiation storms that dynamically alter outpost risk levels.

- Educational Modes & Features: Includes Mission Training with 3 starting scenarios (Artemis Explorer, Solar Maximum Challenge, and Lunar Botanist Expedition), Free Exploration across all 9 districts, an interactive Science Journal, Achievements, and audio narration.

Tools & Technologies Used:

- Built as a browser-friendly 3D web application using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, WebGL/Three.js, and backend API integration for NASA space weather data.
